description.en: The ID of the cloud disk in Cloud Drive Service.

The team space status. Valid values:

- enabled

- disabled

Default value: enabled.

description.zh: 是否添加空间。默认为空，表示查询全部。
description.en:
Specifies whether the space is increased.

- binding: increased

- unbound: not increased

Default value: null. The default value indicates that all spaces are queried.

description.zh: 团队空间名称，支持模糊查询。
description.en: The team name for fuzzy search.

description.zh: 团队类型。默认为空，表示查询全部。
description.en:
The team type.

- org: organizational structure

- directory: workspace

Default value: null. The default value indicates that all types of teams are queried.

description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

- 最大值：100
- 默认值：20
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

- Valid values: 1 to 100

- Default value: 20

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的`NextToken`参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

description.zh:
待查询对象的父节点ID。查询根节点时，填`root`。

默认为空，表示查询全部。
description.en:
The ID of the parent node. If a parent node ID is specified, the subnodes are queried. If you set the value of this parameter to root, the root node is queried.

Default value: null. The default value indicates that all nodes are queried.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。

title.en: Query the list of team shared drives
